event.loss: electrical and engine room items stolen

sources.title: Piracy monthly report February 2025
sources.text: While underway, four perpetrators armed with long knives were sighted boarding from the portside quarter and heading to the engine room. The master raised the alarm and all crew mustered to conduct a search. The crew was not injured. Some electrical and engine room items were stolen.
